mods.name: Video Settings Fix
mods.description: Protects the vanilla graphics preset control and shows video-distance settings while the profiler pie chart is visible.

releases.notes:
Initial release.

Features:
- Protects the Graphics Preset slider from accidental changes
- Hold Shift to intentionally change the preset
- Shows RD, SD and ED while the pie chart is open

Minecraft 26.1.1 / Fabric
How to install

Scroll down to Assets
Click video-settings-fix-1.1.4.jar
Put that .jar file into your Draftout instance’s mods folder
Start Draftout normally

Important: this mod is not currently approved by Draftout, so Draftout will block launch while it’s installed. If you want to test it for now, use a separate test instance.

readmeSummary: A small client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.1 that makes video settings safer and easier to read while using the profiler pie chart.
